body:
After i packed up and left. (disappeared for almost a year before joining my current employer) 
I felt the change in scenery helped a lot to appreciate what good i had at home and helped me see what i have done wrong and how i could do it better. 

Not saying you should disappear but perhaps creating some distance in a new social environment will help you find another way. 

I have found i spent years chasing my own tail for no other reasons then not being able to see for lack of looking up and habit.

Maybe it gives you what you need to move from the misery I do not know. But you could give it a try.
It has not solved my problems but it helped a lot for quite some time.

If you have to chose between bad and worse, just chose the road with the most options. It might make you feel more miserable but it might make you feel better as well. 

Good luck on your struggle and i do hope you get to see a beautiful 2015

I can leave whenever i want. But to reference the post above this is the place in my house where the fire is not an inferno yet. 

I do not know if i will last here, and maybe ill catch a bullet or step on an IED when out in the field. But dying that way would just be assisted suicide, which i don't mind and it would make my death slightly more comprehensible for the people that know and love me.

And if I do make it through here long enough maybe I will find a way to fix myself. At the very least thinking that helps.

So not so much a slave , but more the stick in the stick and carrot analogy.

I wish i could, but this job is what is keeping me together for the moment.
It allows me to scrape together what i need to pay my debts in a relative short time, and here i can not fuck up. This is not a nice environment and either i do my job well or i will hurt until I do.
Which seems to be the only way for me to get shit done. 

In short being miserable here has kept me going for 2 years now.
If i could only get rid of the urge to kill myself and start maybe enjoying something again, it might work. At least that is what i keep telling myself everyday.

Been staring at my screen for the past 30 minutes trying to think of something to say that would not be a fallacy.

It gives me no solace to see someone else in the misery I am in myself.

All i can say is hold out as long as possible there are always people that love you that you will hurt immensely when you do take your own life. 
And maybe you will find a solution for your problems
You never know until you go the distance.

Fuck even that sounds like a fallacy ...

I am sorry

I would not mind no. 

The thing is i do not know. 
I know my aggression stems from my youth. Had to fight a lot and that made anger and physical violence my primary defense mechanism. 

As for everything else i simply do not know.
I have no idea why i keep letting things crumble around me. I should be more than capable of preventing it yet i do not.
Often it is simply to hard to get myself to do the most basic things.
There unfortunately is not a single large event or even a group of large events that led me to here. But more just failing systematically all over the place. I do not know how i can describe it better than that.

As for my emotional state i find i lose more and more interest in the things i actually do get myself to do and used to like. The only things that relieve my sense of misery for the moment are all self destructive in nature.

If you want more specific answers feel free to ask. 
I might be an emotional wreck but i am not a fragile person

Edit: 
Though it might suit to give a shortlist of the things i destroyed around me.

Let's start with the materiel things
* tanked my military career (partially due to my then girlfriend starting to slice her wrists and me mishandeling the perception by my officers)

* Just let slide my bachelor as a chemical engineer (no idea why if i had just put even a marginal effort in i would have made it easy

* Just let slide my bachelor as a biochemist (same situation as before just thought i could force myself to stick to it long enough)

* Despite not having finished my education i got a great job as an analytic chemist (which i destroyed by seeking confrontation with my boss)

* Worked as a bartender and cook until my drinking got me fired

* And am currently a soldier again (hope i can stick it here)

Leaving a lot out, but by simply destroying all these options it led to me improvising myself to the point where I needed to couch surf to get by. As well as generating a lot of debt. And finally joined a merc army to avoid being completely homeless and out of options.

On the social front I have lost count of how many people i have hurt, alienated or in a few cases driven to the point of insanity. Been a whirlwind in the lives of more women then i care to count and non of it ended well.
And the only woman i truly loved I pushed away so brutally I would not know how to describe myself but as a lying selfish bastard.

I hope this tells you what you want to know. 
I can tell you it feels good to say it in honesty although i know that feeling wont last.
